desc: Building on the success of FN’s Tactical pistol family, meet the all-new FN 509 Midsize Tactical. Perfectly suited for concealed carry, home defense and duty use, the multi-role FN 509 Midsize Tactical is red dot and suppressor-ready and offers a full-hand 15-round grip frame with the added option of a 24-round magazine for higher round-count training sessions. The perfectly balanced proportions are optimized for shootability and fast sight acquisition over smaller pistols, giving the user a “just-right” recoil impulse that provides superior control and accuracy at speed. The smooth trigger has a clean break at around 5lbs. For the tactical shooter seeking the perfect balance of capacity and concealability who values quality, and versatility, look no further than the FN 509 Midsize Tactical.
